# sherpa-chat-message

A single chat bubble for AI / messaging threads.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | content |
| Figma | Chat Message |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-chat-message/sherpa-chat-message.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-chat-message/sherpa-chat-message.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-chat-message/sherpa-chat-message.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-chat-message/sherpa-chat-message.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-chat-message/sherpa-chat-message.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-chat-message data-type="assistant" data-name="Sherpa" data-timestamp="10:30" data-message="The answer is 42."></sherpa-chat-message><sherpa-chat-message data-type="user" data-name="You" data-timestamp="10:31" data-message="Thanks."></sherpa-chat-message>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-message` | text |  | optional text body (the default slot overrides it when slotted) |
| `data-name` | text |  | optional author name shown above the bubble |
| `data-timestamp` | text |  | optional timestamp shown beside the name |
| `data-type` | `assistant` `system` `user` | `assistant` | assistant \| user (right, accent) \| system (centred, muted) |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `avatar` | icon | custom avatar content, replaces the default glyph (reflects has-avatar) |
| (default) | content | bubble body content, overrides data-message |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`author`, `avatar`, `bubble`, `message`, `meta`, `time`
